name: OOTD
blurb: Outfit of the day: a post showing what you are wearing today
title: OOTD Meaning: What Does OOTD Stand For on Social Media?
description: OOTD stands for "outfit of the day": a photo or video of what someone is wearing, usually tagged #OOTD on social media. Examples and related tags.
answer: OOTD stands for "outfit of the day". It labels a photo or video of what someone is wearing that day or for a particular occasion, usually posted on social media with the hashtag #OOTD. It is mainly a fashion and lifestyle tag: the point is to show the look, often with where each piece came from.

body: Cambridge defines OOTD as a set of clothes worn by someone on a particular day or occasion, used especially when people post a picture or video of it. A typical OOTD post is a mirror selfie or full-length shot, sometimes with the brands listed in the caption. The exact date the tag started is not well documented; it spread with fashion blogging and photo apps.

body: OOTD is neutral and friendly, part of fashion and lifestyle posting. Writing it in a caption is normal; saying it out loud in conversation usually sounds a bit jokey or online.

faq.q: What is the difference between OOTD and OOTN?
faq.a: OOTD is your outfit for the day; OOTN, outfit of the night, is what you wear to go out in the evening.

faq.q: Can you say OOTD out loud?
faq.a: You can, but it is mostly a written tag. Spoken, it sounds playful, as in "quick OOTD check".
